# Mez Systems product-disc contract

Status: canonical  
Revision: `disc-contract-01`  
Human gate: `H-EXP-01-DISC-PROOF`  
Decision: `DEC-DISC-EXPRESSION-001`  
Production authority: true for the declared disc-expression scope

This package defines one product-disc chassis for the five approved Mez Systems cores. It does not copy or alter gradients, product assignments, the Living Core renderer, foundation packages, consumer code or Figma.

The candidate recommendation is precise: a hard circular mask, canonical white Wings at a `0.39` width ratio from 48 px upward, exact source-derived static twins by default, and no more than one approved parametric runtime per viewport. A 24–47 px unmarked core is only a colour indicator paired with a visible product name; it is not a complete product lockup.

Run from the repository root:

```bash
python3 brand-kit/expressions/disc/build_disc_contract.py
python3 brand-kit/expressions/disc/verify_disc_contract.py
```

Review the canonical proof and permanent approval record at `/brand-kit/workbench/expressions/disc/`. This bounded authority covers the disc expression only. Sphere, card, pill, stack, homepage, Figma and consumer authority remain separate gates.
